veranderings.voor: By latere gemeenskappe en vandag nog is twee soorte tradisionele genesers bekend.
veranderings.na: By latere gemeenskappe was twee soorte tradisionele genesers bekend, en dit is vandag nog so.
veranderings.rede: One present-tense verb is stretched over a past phrase (later communities) and a present one (today); splitting the tenses reads naturally and keeps 'bekend', 'tradisionele genesers' and the meaning.
'vandag nog steeds' doubles up; 'vandag nog' already says it still happens today.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry is 'nyanga', but the lesson writes 'inyanga' throughout, including the glossary headword, so the whole-word protection never matches anything in this lesson; a person should check whether the entry should read 'inyanga' (or both) so the guard actually protects it.
